summary: Solo Denver woman fell ~900 ft near the summit of Capitol Peak, plunging 1,500-2,000 ft into Pierre Lakes Basin after a handhold rock gave way.
location: Capitol Peak summit area / Pierre Lakes Basin, Elk Range
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Mountain Rescue Aspen; helicopters
notes: Witness reported seeing the solo climber fall ~8am Saturday; mountain rescue teams and helicopters recovered the body; identity not released as of 2022-09-06. Merged run 519: advnture.com account of the 900-ft solo-climber fall (knife-edge-to-summit route, handhold broke away, fell into Pierre Lakes Basin; hiker witnessed the fall early Saturday morning, emergency services alerted). Climbing.com "One Climber Killed, Others Rescued On Capitol Peak" (parent-opened run 606): solo woman fell ~900 ft after pulling on loose rock near summit, shortly after crossing the Knife Edge, Sept 3. Merged run 678: KOA/iHeart 2022-09-06 account carries the Pitkin County SO statement — 2 MRA volunteers flown to K2 for radio communications/safety/trail closure, 4 flown into Pierre Lakes Basin to hike to the body and prepare extraction.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Capitol Peak)
